ix_properties_public_listings.name: ix_properties_public_listings
ix_properties_public_listings.where: "properties"."listing_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."listing_hidden_at" IS NULL

ck_properties_listing.name: ck_properties_listing
ck_properties_listing.value: "properties"."listing_price_cents" IS NULL OR ("properties"."listing_price_cents" > 0 AND "properties"."listing_consented_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_manual_rentals_values.name: ck_manual_rentals_values
ck_manual_rentals_values.value: "property_manual_rentals"."monthly_rent_cents" >= 0 AND ("property_manual_rentals"."due_day" IS NULL OR "property_manual_rentals"."due_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31)
